1600	But if you add one more Torah class, then from that same water boiler the water that comes out is of higher
1601	quality, there will be more abundance, more blessing.
1602	There is no point in expanding in the material; the point is to expand in the spiritual.
1603	Expand there, not here.
1604	So first of all, know that this is the counsel of Satan and the yetzer hara.
1605	Second, "if you grasp too much, you have not grasped."
1606	And these things, gentlemen, apply to all kinds of people.
1607	They apply to me too, as a person in my profession, in what I am.
1608	Have you ever seen a cardiologist?
1609	What do they call the one who works in the cities?
1610	Chaim, what do you call him?
1611	A cardiologist?
1612	What does this cardiologist do?
1613	He treats hearts.
1614	A good heart.
1615	That is his work.
1616	Or a person who is a brain surgeon.
1617	He has a profession; he is trained in his profession.
1618	Now they tell him, listen, this one has a bit of a cough, come examine him.
1619	Is this cardiologist now going to examine the one with the cough and give him something?
1620	But what, you are a doctor, you know the brain, you know.
1621	Brother, it's true that I studied this too, but if I now go from my role as a cardiologist to being also
1622	a doctor here for the flu and things like that, I will lose my cardiology as well.
1623	"If you grasp too much, you have not grasped."
1624	Stay with what the Creator of the world placed you in, invest where the Creator of the world placed you, and don't let
1625	the Satan side drag you into a lot of other things.
1626	I am a person who, thank God, has been going around with the public for many years.
1627	Dozens of times people came to me: Rabbi, shalom bayit, only you, only you, my husband listens only
1628	to you.
1629	My wife listens only to you.
1630	Say a word here, say a word there.
1631	And it may be that if I do this, I do this.
1632	But I started to understand that if I go to this project, I lose what I am here.
1633	Do what you want; there are people for whom this is their role.
1634	I have a different role.
1635	"If you grasp too much, you have not grasped"; this is the counsel of Satan, the counsel of the yetzer hara.
1636	"When Rabbi Yose died, the clusters ceased."
1637	People who go both after this and after that.
1638	How many times people came, best friends, Rabbi, he took money from me, this one brought me money, this and that,
1639	only you, one word from you, and we will close the matter.
